hints.title: Start Search from Every Non-Zero Cell
hints.text: Any cell containing gold can serve as the origin of an optimal digging path.

hints.title: Explore Four Cardinal Directions with Restoration
hints.text: Temporarily mark the current cell as zero to prevent revisit cycles, explore neighbors, and restore the value upon return.

hints.title: Accumulate Maximum Across All Traversal Paths
hints.text: Take the maximum gold collected across all four branching directions plus the current cell value.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: K: number of cells containing gold (at most 25)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded grid paths without cycle marking loop infinitely.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since at most 25 cells have gold, backtracking with in-place cell marking completes within time limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should restore cell values properly upon return to preserve grid state across branches.
complexity.notes: No cell can be visited more than once in a single path.
